test_camera_eye_at_up_inversion: test that camera_to_eye_at_up correctly inverts look_at_view_transform to recover eye, at, and up vectors
test_rotate_on_spot_yaw: test rotate_on_spot yaw rotation around the y axis to look left while keeping eye position fixed
test_rotate_on_spot_pitch: test rotate_on_spot pitch rotation around the x axis to look down while keeping eye position fixed
test_rotate_on_spot_roll: test rotate_on_spot roll rotation around the z axis to rotate the camera image clockwise
test_batched_dotprod: test the _batched_dotprod helper function that computes batched dot products of two N by 3 tensors
